basis: Observed official workbook schema, contract identity and completion/status audit; no confirmation price values or model results inspected by root.
reason: Avoid mixing EUA phase 2 and phase 3/4 contract targets on the same day. Official worksheets label T3PA as EUA and distinguish aviation contracts.
no_status_rule: Require valid date, positive finite clearing price, auction volume and revenue, abs(revenue-price*volume)<=0.01 EUR, and no failure/cancellation marker. Label inferred_completed, never explicit successful.
status_rule: Require explicit successful status and the same positive finite value and revenue identity checks. Canceled auctions excluded, no imputation.
daily_aggregation: Auction-volume-weighted price for same-date eligible T3PA auctions only; preserve original components locally.
